versions.short: The bill would allow the National Park Service to extend certain existing leases for businesses operating in national park areas without first requesting bids or proposals from other companies, provided the lessee has held the lease for at least five years, is complying with its terms, and the extension fits the purposes of the park. The Director could grant only one such extension before a new competitive bidding process would be required, and the total length of an extended lease would still have to follow existing rules. The bill would also direct the Secretary of the Interior to revise the related regulations within 90 days of enactment to reflect this new authority.
